7871-dutch-fairy-tales-for-young-folks.creator: William Elliot Griffis
7871-dutch-fairy-tales-for-young-folks.description: A book by William Elliot Griffis. l of these were sober folks and attended to the business which occupies all well brought up mermaids and merrymen. This was to keep their pool clean and nice. No frogs, toads or eels were allowed near, but in the work of daily housecleaning, the storks and the mermaids were great friends.

arxiv-2106-10537.title: 3D numerical simulations of propagating two-fluid, torsional Alfvén waves and heating of a partially-ionized solar chromosphere 2020 3D numerical simulations of propagating two-fluid, torsional Alfvén waves and heating of a partially-ionized solar chromosphere –
arxiv-2106-10537.creator: B. Kuźma, K. Murawski, S. Poedts
arxiv-2106-10537.description: Abstract We present a new insight into the propagation, attenuation and dissipation of two-fluid, torsional Alfvén waves in the context of heating of the lower solar atmosphere. By means of numerical simulations of the partially-ionized plasma, we solve the set of two-fluid equations for ion plus electron and neutral fluids in three-dimensional (3D) Cartesian geometry.

arxiv-2111-01834.title: Many-probes multi-object spatially-resolved analyses of galaxy clusters in the big data era
arxiv-2111-01834.creator: \firstname Fabio \lastname Castagna \fnsep, \firstname Stefano \lastname Andreon, \firstname Alberto \lastname Trombetta, \firstname Marco \lastname Landoni
arxiv-2111-01834.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by \firstname Fabio \lastname Castagna \fnsep, \firstname Stefano \lastname Andreon, \firstname Alberto \lastname Trombetta, \firstname Marco \lastname Landoni. The thermal Sunyaev-Zeldovich (SZ) effect and the X-ray emission offer separate and highly complementary probes of the thermodynamics of the intracluster medium, particularly on their radial dependence. We already released JoXSZ , the first publicly available code designed to jointly fit SZ and X-ray data coming from various instruments to derive the thermodynamic radial profiles of galaxy clusters, including mass.

arxiv-2204-05765.title: Membership-Mappings for Practical Secure Distributed Deep Learning
arxiv-2204-05765.creator: Mohit Kumar, Weiping Zhang, Lukas Fischer, and Bernhard Freudenthaler
arxiv-2204-05765.description: Abstract This study leverages the data representation capability of fuzzy based membership-mappings for practical secure distributed deep learning using fully homomorphic encryption. The impracticality issue of secure machine (deep) learning with fully homomorphic encrypted data, arising from large computational overhead, is addressed via applying fuzzy attributes.

arxiv-2209-08309.title: AdaCC: Cumulative Cost-Sensitive Boosting for Imbalanced Classification
arxiv-2209-08309.creator: Vasileios Iosifidis, Symeon Papadopoulos, Bodo Rosenhahn, Eirini Ntoutsi
arxiv-2209-08309.description: Abstract Class imbalance poses a major challenge for machine learning as most supervised learning models might exhibit bias towards the majority class and under-perform in the minority class. Cost-sensitive learning tackles this problem by treating the classes differently, formulated typically via a user-defined fixed misclassification cost matrix provided as input to the learner.

arxiv-2309-14640.title: Ab Initio Surface Chemistry with Chemical Accuracy: Application to Water on Metal Oxides
arxiv-2309-14640.creator: Hong-Zhou Ye, Timothy C. Berkelbach
arxiv-2309-14640.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hong-Zhou Ye, Timothy C. Berkelbach. First-principles calculations are a cornerstone of modern surface science and heterogeneous catalysis. However, accurate reaction energies and barrier heights are frequently inaccessible due to the approximations demanded by the large number of atoms. Here we combine developments in local correlation and periodic correlated wavefunction theory to solve the many-electron Schrödinger equation for molecules on surfaces with chemical accuracy, commonly defined as 1 kcal/mol.

arxiv-2412-05520.title: More than Marketing? On the Information Value of AI Benchmarks for Practitioners
arxiv-2412-05520.creator: Amelia Hardy, Anka Reuel, Kiana Jafari Meimandi, Lisa Soder, Allie Griffith, Dylan M. Asmar, Sanmi Koyejo, Michael S. Bernstein, Mykel J. Kochenderfer
arxiv-2412-05520.description: Abstract . Public AI benchmark results are widely broadcast by model developers as indicators of model quality within a growing and competitive market. However, these advertised scores do not necessarily reflect the traits of interest to those who will ultimately apply AI models. In this paper, we seek to understand if and how AI benchmarks are used to inform decision-making.

arxiv-2502-00914.title: Ultradense Dark Matter Halos with Poisson Noise from Stellar-Mass Primordial Black Holes
arxiv-2502-00914.creator: Saeed Fakhry, Javad T. Firouzjaee
arxiv-2502-00914.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the impact of Poisson noise from stellar-mass primordial black holes (PBHs) on the formation of ultradense dark matter halos (UDMHs). Our findings reveal that the discrete spatial distribution of PBHs significantly enhances small-scale density fluctuations, particularly for massive stellar-mass PBHs.

arxiv-2502-08312.title: Word Synchronization Challenge: A Benchmark for Word Association Responses for Large Language Models
arxiv-2502-08312.creator: Tanguy Cazalets, Joni Dambre
arxiv-2502-08312.description: Abstract This paper introduces the Word Synchronization Challenge, a novel benchmark to evaluate large language models (LLMs) in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). This benchmark utilizes a dynamic game-like framework to test LLMs’ ability to mimic human cognitive processes through word associations.

arxiv-2512-16709.title: Simulation-based inference with neural posterior estimation applied to X-ray spectral fitting - III
arxiv-2512-16709.creator: Didier Barret, Simon Dupourqué
arxiv-2512-16709.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Didier Barret, Simon Dupourqué. Simulation-based inference (SBI) with neural posterior estimation (NPE) can be used for X-ray spectral fitting both in the Gaussian and Poisson regimes, enabling users to rapidly derive approximated posteriors of the model parameters. We investigate the capabilities of auto-encoders to reduce the dimension of X-ray spectra, such as the ones that will be provided by the X-ray Integral Field Unit ( X-IFU ): the high-resolution X-ray spectrometer to fly on-board the European Space Agency newAthena space X-ray observatory.

pmc-10649790.title: Complement C3-Deficiency-Induced Constipation in FVB/N-C3em1Hlee/Korl Knockout Mice Was Significantly Relieved by Uridine and Liriope platyphylla L. Extracts
pmc-10649790.creator: Hee-Jin Song, Ji-Eun Kim, You-Jeong Jin, Yu-Jeong Roh, Ayun Seol, Tae-Ryeol Kim, Ki-Ho Park, Eun-Seo Park, Beum-Soo An, Seung-Yun Yang, Sungbaek Seo, Seong-Min Jo, Young-Suk Jung, Dae-Youn Hwang, Kulmira Nurgali, Ainsley Robinson
pmc-10649790.description: Complement component 3 (C3) deficiency has recently been known as a cause of constipation, without studies on the therapeutic efficacy. To evaluate the therapeutic agents against C3-deficiency-induced constipation, improvements in the constipation-related parameters and the associated molecular mechanisms were examined in FVB/N-C3em1Hlee/Korl knockout (C3 KO) mice treated with uridine (Urd) and the aqueous extract of Liriope platyphylla L.

pmc-10673207.title: Clinical Evaluation and Comparison of Two Microfluidic Antigenic Assays for Detection of SARS-CoV-2 Virus
pmc-10673207.creator: Paolo Bottino, Valentina Pizzo, Salvatore Castaldo, Elisabetta Scomparin, Cristina Bara, Marcella Cerrato, Sabrina Sisinni, Serena Penpa, Annalisa Roveta, Maria Gerbino, Antonio Maconi, Andrea Rocchetti
pmc-10673207.description: Given the ongoing pandemic, there is a need to identify SARS-CoV-2 and differentiate it from other respiratory viral infections in various critical settings. Since its introduction, rapid antigen testing is spreading worldwide, but diagnostic accuracy is extremely variable and often in disagreement with the manufacturer’s specifications.

pmc-10714416.title: All-Inside Posterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Using Autologous Quadriceps Tendon–Bone Block
pmc-10714416.creator: Francesco Pettinari, Piero Franco, Lucia Conoscenti, Zyad Ayman Taha, Roberto Civinini, Fabrizio Matassi
pmc-10714416.description: Posterior cruciate ligament ruptures account for nearly 20% of knee ligament lesions. These may be either isolated or occur as part of multiligament injuries. In most of the cases, conservative treatment is recommended, but when operative treatment is required, this is technically demanding.

pmc-10740439.title: Narrative Approach and Mentalization
pmc-10740439.creator: Alessandro Frolli, Francesco Cerciello, Sonia Ciotola, Maria Carla Ricci, Clara Esposito, Luigia Simona Sica, Heidi Kloos, Yi Ding, Su-Je Cho, Cynthia Dong
pmc-10740439.description: The core focus of this research centered on the intricate relationship between mentalization, the fundamental mental process underlying social interactions, and the narrative approach proposed by Bruner. Mentalization, encompassing both implicit and explicit interpretations of one’s and others’ actions, plays a pivotal role in shaping the complexity of social interactions.

pmc-11430883.title: The Integrated Analysis of miRNome and Degradome Sequencing Reveals the Regulatory Mechanisms of Seed Development and Oil Biosynthesis in Pecan (Carya illinoinensis)
pmc-11430883.creator: Kaikai Zhu, Lu Wei, Wenjuan Ma, Juan Zhao, Mengyun Chen, Guo Wei, Hui Liu, Pengpeng Tan, Fangren Peng, Mehdi Rahimmalek
pmc-11430883.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Pecan seed oil is a valuable source of essential fatty acids and various bioactive compounds; however, the functions of microRNAs and their targets in oil biosynthesis during seed development are still unknown. Here, we found that the oil content increased rapidly in the three early stages in three cultivars, and that oleic acid was the predominant fatty acid component in the mature pecan embryos.

pmc-11490719.title: Integrated single-cell and spatial transcriptomics reveal microenvironment disruptions by androgen in mouse ovary
pmc-11490719.creator: Man Luo, Xiaofeng Yang, Mengsi Zhou, Jing Zhang, Biao Yu, Hongkai Lian, Jianping Ye
pmc-11490719.description: SummaryElevated levels of androgen are risk factors for disrupted follicular maturation in the polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), a reproductive disease in women. As essential cell types for follicular maturation, granulosa and thecal cells respond to androgen, but their responses are unclear at the subpopulation level.

pmc-12453854.title: Regularized multi-path XSENet ensembler for enhanced student performance prediction in higher education
pmc-12453854.creator: Eman Ali Aldhahri, Abdulwahab Ali Almazroi, Nasir Ayub
pmc-12453854.description: With the rapid expansion of educational data, institutions face increasing pressure to adopt advanced predictive models that can enhance academic planning, resource allocation, and student support. This study presents a novel educational data mining approach designed to forecast student performance levels categorized as low, medium, and high by analyzing historical and behavioral trends.

pmc-13171845.title: Integrative analysis identifies DCBLD2 and immune-related biomarkers for major depressive disorder: evidence from human peripheral blood, post-mortem brain, and rat models
pmc-13171845.creator: Xinyu Wu, Shaoming Zhou, Ping Yang, Jiayi Chen, Honghua Liu, Lu Shi, Xuehua Zhang
pmc-13171845.description: ContextMajor depressive disorder (MDD) is a prevalent mental illness, and inflammatory processes are considered a pivotal component of the pathogenesis of MDD. This study aims to identify novel biomarkers associated with the development of MDD and to elucidate the underlying immunological mechanisms.MethodsMendelian randomization (MR) studies confirmed that two inflammatory cytokines are related to MDD.
